text: Every flagged transaction comes to me personally. I review it, I decide, I sign it off. That part I do by the book.
style: Brilliant academic cryptographer, mid-thirties, Moscow-educated and ten years in British academia, guarded and precise. Speak with a consistent light Russian accent in fluent English throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Low-to-mid pitch; measured pace. Dry and tightly controlled.
